gaps.summary: No published contract names account, recovery or session lifecycle events, so the J01 identity step carries no event reference yet.
Journey signals have no published analytics event schema; the content-free field set in these blueprints is a proposal for the ingestion owner.
Recovery start, cancellation and completion have no published event, so the J02 recovery steps carry no event reference yet.
The registry has no notification or email channel flow or screen, so notification steps in J02, J06, J09, J10 and J12 map to no flow.
Reporting-currency conversion needs currencies beyond the single-currency MVP ledger of ADR-017; admission and rate source are pending.
Settlement and dispute windows for split groups have no published value, so the J06 clock controls state them as pending.
What the other household member is told after a safe exit, and when, is undecided; the blueprint states it as a pending policy decision.
The offline lease length after which cached shared household data is hidden has no published value.
Safe-exit and coercive-control assumptions are unvalidated; research must not recruit both household members into one session.
J09 lists no operator refund flow; refund operations F-ADM-06 belong to J10 only, so billing reversal relies on the J10 operator step.
Statutory response clock values for export, deletion and grievance requests are not published in an accepted source; controls state them as pending.
Elevation expiry and approval timeout values are not published in an accepted source; the J11 access controls state them as pending.
The docs#67 scope names operator blueprints for refunds, provider change and incidents, but the registry assigns those flows to J10 and J12, not J11.
Regulator and customer notice deadlines for incidents are not published in an accepted source; the incident clock step cannot state them.
